scope.audio: One explicitly selected source at a time: system playback by default (all apps on the selected render endpoint) or microphone. Never mix or automatically switch to the mic.
scope.ui: Tool Box page, movable optionally pinned overlay without focus stealing on updates, prominent Vietnamese final captions, optional English, Start/Pause/Resume/Stop and configurable shortcut that only opens the UI.
scope.privacy: Local-only processing; no audio/transcript persistence, telemetry, or transmitting meeting content to a remote service. Audio starts only on explicit Start/Resume. Pause/Stop/close releases the capture endpoint. Switching releases old endpoint and invalidates queued results first.

plan_review.scope: Approved to start Phase 1, not an acceptance pass; review refinements incorporated below.

phases.title: Capture and recognition benchmark
tasks: Run Windows capture proof for real endpoint playback through headphones and a real mic, including selecting devices and release on Stop. Clearly separate fixture/virtual from physical evidence.

Compare whisper.cpp base.en and sherpa-onnx streaming English Zipformer 20M using the same pinned, synthetic or consented meeting fixtures. Freeze a held-out manifest (at least 40 utterances, varied voices, annotated speech-end times, pre-scored facts, critical negations and silence controls), model hashes/config and scoring denominators before collecting results. Use identical wall-clock-paced input on the same build/hardware and timestamp publication of a visible final caption. Benchmark current local LFM 450M as text translator separately before testing end to end. Do not change OCR defaults.

Log software and machine configuration, comparable workload, model/download size separately from deployed size, cold load, steady CPU/RAM, queue/drop counts, raw latencies and annotated accuracy; retain no real meeting content.

acceptance.case: Physical mic and headphone playback verified separately; no silent fallback, endpoint closes on Stop, no fixture substituted for physical verification. Operator confirms physical selected headphone playback and distinct identifiable physical mic input without cross-source leakage. Hosted/virtual checks may be collected first but cannot pass this case.

Speaker-diverse annotated fixtures cover accents, names, numbers, silence and negation; score end-to-end stable Vietnamese captions from end of speech using warmed models. Provisional goals median <=2.5 s, p95 <=5 s, >=90% pre-scored details preserved with zero critical negation reversals. Missing/dropped captions count against coverage and as +infinity for latency percentiles, and no final captions may appear in silence controls.
Benchmark artifacts justify selected local engines and explicitly list limitations. Independent Advisor approval.
Tool Box and remappable unbound-by-default shortcut open one UI without starting capture; known existing shortcuts still work; rebinding and restart tested on Windows.

Bilingual overlay shows stable accessible captions without stealing focus; manual Pause/Resume/Stop/close and device loss reflect state. A bounded worker pipeline rejects obsolete events after Pause, Stop, source/device changes or shutdown; verify real overlay latency against Phase 1 target.

Use loopback-only inference endpoints without cloud fallback; use content-free logs/errors. No cloud or disk sink for audio or captions; no output from old sessions. Show actionable errors for missing models, unsupported device, or disabled microphone permission. Independent Advisor approval.
Ordinary non-e2e Windows build runs a representative 60-minute soak with no growing lag/memory/queue; record evidence and observed device/runtime limitations.
Real Windows mic and headphones, device removal/reconnect, locked full suite, existing tool UI regression, and release archive smoke. Do not claim physical evidence based only on virtual endpoints.
Independent Advisor reviews the exact release tree; attach run evidence before marking passed or merging. No tag or release publication implied.

gate.rule: Advisor reviews plan before Luna codes; each later phase waits on prior phase evidence and review. Main stays unchanged until exact integrated product is reviewed and acceptance passes.
